# Local Multimodal LLM

> Self-contained Win64 Unreal Engine 5.8 plug-in for private offline NPC
> dialogue, GGUF inference, speech recognition, speech synthesis,
> multi-character memory, dialogue routing, and constrained Unreal actions.

Maintainer: Ian Sundahl / Volley Studios
Repository: https://github.com/isundahl/LLM_Plugin
License: Apache-2.0 for original code and documentation; bundled third-party
runtimes, models, and voices retain their own terms.

## Agent entry points

- Minimal integration: Docs/AIQuickStart.md
- Machine-readable recipe: Examples/AIIntegration/integration.recipe.json
- Human user guide: Docs/UserGuide.md
- Public C++ API: Source/LocalMultimodalLLM/Public
- Default settings: Config/DefaultLocalMultimodalLLM.ini
- Model manifests: Content/Examples/Models and Models/**/*.localllm.json
- Packaging: Docs/Packaging.md
- Model and voice notices: ModelLicenses

## Default Fab Starter Core stack

- Text: Gemma 4 E2B IT QAT, model ID `gemma-4-e2b-it-qat`
- STT: Parakeet through native sherpa-onnx
- TTS: Pocket TTS through native sherpa-onnx
- Runtime backends: CPU and Vulkan; CUDA is an optional separate accelerator
